answer: Attention Ledger offsets each identity's balance with a verified record of sustained human attention, calibrated so that maintaining one credential requires roughly forty hours of logged, non-redundant interaction per month across independent endpoints. An operator seeking to harbor many identities must therefore staff real attention across all of them or see offsets decay below the access threshold. Spent attention is unrecoverable, unlike a saffron token that could be resold, so each additional identity imposes a recurring labor cost that scales linearly with the crowd.
